display.purpose: Hero headline only, e.g. 'Care That Comes to You'.

headline-h1.purpose: Page titles and top-level section headers.

body.purpose: Default UI text, the 16px accessibility floor.

small.purpose: Captions, field error text, helper copy only.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for cards, scrolled header, CTA buttons.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Hover elevation for cards/buttons, paired with a small upward translate.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default 250ms ease-out for hover/scroll transitions (shadow, translate, color, background).

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-triggered section/card entrance via the Reveal component, staggered per item.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single dominant call to action per view (e.g. 'Get A Quote').
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 20px; background: #183891; color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0px 4px 20px rgba(24,56,145,0.08); transition: background 250ms ease-out, box-shadow 250ms ease-out, transform 250ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: #0F2461; box-shadow: 0px 8px 28px rgba(24,56,145,0.14); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E68A25; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action beside a primary CTA (e.g. 'Log in', 'Sign out').
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 8px; background: transparent; border: none; color: #183891; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; text-underline-offset: 4px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E68A25; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: Feature/service card with image, title, description, and CTA — the canonical card used across services and testimonials.
components.html:
Personal Care

Daily living assistance tailored to your family's needs.

Learn more
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; border-radius: 24px; border: 1px solid #E3E6ED; background: #ffffff; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0px 4px 20px rgba(24,56,145,0.08); transition: box-shadow 250ms ease-out, transform 250ms ease-out; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0px 8px 28px rgba(24,56,145,0.14); transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-card-img { height: 192px; width: 100%; border-radius: 12px; object-fit: cover; } .ds-card-title { margin-top: 20px; font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; color: #1A1D29; } .ds-card-body { margin-top: 8px; flex: 1; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; color: #5B6070; } .ds-card-cta { margin-top: 24px; display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 20px; background: #183891; color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background 250ms ease-out, transform 250ms ease-out; } .ds-card-cta:hover { background: #0F2461; transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Labeled form field with above-field label, 48px minimum height, and kindly-worded inline error state.
components.html: That doesn't look like an email — mind checking it?
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: #1A1D29; } .ds-field-required { color: #D64545; } .ds-field-input { min-height: 48px; width: 100%; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid #E3E6ED; background: #ffffff; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 16px; color: #1A1D29; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: #9AA0B0; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E68A25; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field-error { font-size: 14px; color: #D64545; }

components.css: .ds-header { position: sticky; top: 0; background: #ffffff; transition: box-shadow 250ms ease-out, background 250ms ease-out; } .ds-header-inner { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 12px 24px; } .ds-header-logo { font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; color: #183891; text-decoration: none; } .ds-header-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; } .ds-header-link { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: #5B6070; text-decoration: none; transition: color 250ms ease-out; } .ds-header-link:hover { color: #183891; } .ds-header-link-active { color: #183891; } .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 20px; background: #183891; color: #ffffff; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0px 4px 20px rgba(24,56,145,0.08); transition: background 250ms ease-out, transform 250ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0F2461; transform: translateY(-2px); }

narrative.overview: Care Connect looks like a knowledgeable friend sitting down with you at the kitchen table, not a hospital intake form. Every surface is built to lower an anxious family member's cognitive load first and impress second: generous whitespace, large legible type, soft rounded geometry echoing the logo's two interlocking figures, and a blue-and-orange palette used with restraint — deep trust-blue for structure and navigation, warm amber reserved for the moments that need action. The system explicitly rejects clinical/cold hospital aesthetics (sterile whites, sharp corners, dense tables) and rejects flashy/gimmicky startup polish (aggressive motion, novelty for its own sake). Confidence is expressed through calm, not through volume.
keyCharacteristics: Rounded, embracing geometry throughout (12–24px radii) — no sharp corners
Blue-tinted soft shadows, not generic gray, tying elevation back to brand
One accent color (amber) reserved for action; everything else stays in blue/neutral
Type sized up from typical SaaS defaults (16px body floor) for an older audience
Motion is a whisper: 200–300ms ease-out fades and lifts, never parallax or flourish

rules.name: The Blue-First Rule
rules.body: Trust Blue says "act now" as well as "this is structure." Warm Amber does not appear as a CTA fill; it is held for rare secondary highlights only, so the page reads as one confident blue system rather than two competing accents.

rules.name: The 16px Floor Rule
rules.body: Body copy never renders below 16px anywhere in the product. This is a firm accessibility line for an audience that includes aging users and their families reading on small screens.

rules.name: The Lift-on-Intent Rule
rules.body: Nothing elevates until the user's cursor says they're interested. Cards and buttons sit flat (shadow-card) at rest and rise to shadow-card-hover with a -translate-y nudge only on hover/focus — elevation is a response, not a static decoration.

dos: Do fill every primary CTA with Trust Blue + white text; blue carries both structure and action.
Do keep every interactive element at a 44×44px minimum tap target, and inputs at 48px minimum height.
Do use the blue-tinted shadow-card / shadow-card-hover pair for all elevation — never a generic gray box-shadow.
Do label every form field above the input, permanently visible, never placeholder-only.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion on every animated element (Reveal, toast-in).
donts: Don't use Warm Amber as a button/CTA fill — it's a reserve secondary highlight now, not the action color.
Don't use sharp corners anywhere — the system has no 0px-radius surfaces.
Don't let color alone signal state (error, required, active) — always pair with icon, text, or an asterisk.
Don't set body copy below 16px, even for dense UI or captions-adjacent text.
Don't add parallax, aggressive scroll effects, or motion longer than ~400ms — the audience skews older and easily disoriented by flashy motion.
